name: ai-reading-coach
description: Reading Bloom — AI reading coach (React + NestJS monorepo).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @reading-coach/api && npm run build -w @reading-coach/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
